user.title: Configure HomeKit Device Aggregator
user.description: Choose a name and type for your aggregated device

device_config.title: Configure Device Entities
device_config.description: Select the entities to combine into a single HomeKit device

data.keep_warm_mode: Keep Warm Mode (switch, toggle or two-option select)

error.tilt_same_as_lift: The tilt cover must be a different entity, unless it supports tilt control itself

device_descriptions.kettle: Combines power, current temperature and target temperature into a single HomeKit thermostat
device_descriptions.thermostat: Groups temperature sensors and controls under one device (no aggregated thermostat entity yet)
device_descriptions.fan: Groups fan controls under one device; a single fan accessory only when the power entity is a fan
device_descriptions.light: Groups light controls under one device (no aggregated light entity yet)
device_descriptions.humidifier: Groups humidity sensing and control under one device (no aggregated humidifier entity yet)
device_descriptions.air_purifier: Groups an air purifier's controls and air quality sensors under one device
device_descriptions.garage_door: Groups door sensors and light under one device (no aggregated garage door accessory yet)
device_descriptions.security_system: Groups security sensors and siren under one device (no aggregated alarm accessory yet)
device_descriptions.star_projector: Groups a master switch, rotation fan and laser/background lights under one device
device_descriptions.electric_blanket: Combines a power switch and per-zone heat-level selects into per-zone HomeKit heaters
device_descriptions.shutter: Combines separate lift and tilt cover entities into a single HomeKit window covering

entity_descriptions.power_switch: Main power control — accepts a switch or a fan entity (fan-domain power exposes percentage speed in HomeKit)
entity_descriptions.target_temperature: Sets the target water temperature. Use the kettle's own number entity if it has one, otherwise an input_number helper
entity_descriptions.countdown_timer: Shows remaining time for the current operation
entity_descriptions.keep_warm_mode: Controls the keep warm function. Accepts a switch, an input_boolean, or a select whose options include an on/off pair such as True/False. A select with more than two options is on only while it sits on the matched on option, and turning it on from HomeKit selects that option
entity_descriptions.water_level: Monitors the water level in the device
entity_descriptions.air_quality: Shows the overall air quality reading
entity_descriptions.filter_life: Monitors the air filter's remaining life
entity_descriptions.pm25: Shows the PM2.5 particulate matter level
entity_descriptions.voc: Shows the Volatile Organic Compounds level
entity_descriptions.child_lock: Switch that locks/unlocks the device's physical controls
entity_descriptions.display_switch: Switch that turns the device's display on or off
entity_descriptions.zone_body: Heat-level select for the body zone (Off + levels 1-6)
entity_descriptions.zone_feet: Heat-level select for the feet zone (Off + levels 1-6)
entity_descriptions.body_timer: Optional auto-off timer select for the body zone
entity_descriptions.feet_timer: Optional auto-off timer select for the feet zone
entity_descriptions.door_position: Controls and monitors the door position
entity_descriptions.laser_light: Star/laser projection light with brightness control
entity_descriptions.background_light: Nebula/background light with brightness and colour control
entity_descriptions.rotation_fan: Fan entity that controls rotation speed of the projection
entity_descriptions.lift_cover: Cover entity that raises and lowers the shutter
entity_descriptions.tilt_cover: Cover entity that angles the slats - used directly if it supports setting a tilt position, otherwise its lift position is driven instead
entity_descriptions.obstruction_detected: Detects obstructions in the door's path
